title: TrueLend persisted and derived entities
description: Every $defs key is a term in specs/design/CONTEXT.md (decision D-H). Money is a quoted 2-decimal string at every hop (decision D-G); no monetary property is a number.

EMI.title: EMI
EMI.description: Equated Monthly Installment. Quoted 2dp decimal string.

TotalPayable.title: Total Payable
TotalPayable.description: Sum of every Installment principal and interest across a Repayment Schedule.

RoundingResidual.title: Rounding Residual
RoundingResidual.description: Difference between the unrounded EMI stream and its 2dp representation, absorbed wholly by the final Installment (decision D-C).

OutstandingPrincipal.title: Outstanding Principal
OutstandingPrincipal.description: Stored projection: disbursed principal minus the applied principal of posted Repayments. Reconcilable by replay.

CorrelationId.title: Correlation Id
CorrelationId.description: Request-scoped identifier carried by every structured log line emitted while handling one request.

Role.title: Role
Role.description: Exactly one per User. Enforced at the controller layer.

User.title: User
User.description: Table app_user. An authenticated actor holding exactly one Role.

AuditEntry.title: Audit Entry
AuditEntry.description: Table audit_event. Insert-only (decision D-E). Records actor, action and entity id as opaque values.

Threshold.title: Threshold
Threshold.description: One configurable bound inside Policy Rules. Changing it means publishing a new Policy Version.

ReasonCode.title: Reason Code
ReasonCode.description: Declared by a Policy Version. A decision may cite only codes declared by the version pinned to its application.

RequiredDocument.title: Required Document
RequiredDocument.description: A document type a Loan Product demands, declared by the Policy Version.

PolicyRules.title: Policy Rules
PolicyRules.description: The validated threshold document carried by a Policy Version, stored as JSONB and validated by a Pydantic model (decision D-A). No expression DSL exists.

PolicyVersion.title: Policy Version
PolicyVersion.description: Table policy_version. Insert-only: never updated, never deleted, in code or in migration.

ActivePolicyVersion.title: Active Policy Version
ActivePolicyVersion.description: Derived, not a table. The Policy Version whose id equals product.active_policy_version_id. An is_active column on policy_version is impossible: flipping it would be an UPDATE the immutability test forbids.

LoanProduct.title: Loan Product
LoanProduct.description: Table product. Carries no thresholds; its rules live in its Policy Versions. A new product is an INSERT with no deploy (decision D-A).

Applicant.title: Applicant
Applicant.description: Inlined on the application row: exactly one per Loan Application, so a child table would model a cardinality the requirements deny.

ApplicationSubmission.title: Application Submission
ApplicationSubmission.description: The inbound payload that creates a Loan Application.

ApplicationStatus.title: Application Status
ApplicationStatus.description: Mutable projection of the append-only facts recorded against the application. Seven states per D-L, which added MANUAL_REVIEW to the Application Status term in CONTEXT.md and to this enum.

CreditScore.title: Credit Score
CreditScore.description: Deterministic score from age, income and credit-history flags. Not a bureau score.

CreditScoreStub.title: Credit Score Stub
CreditScoreStub.description: Derived, not a table. The in-process stand-in for a credit bureau behind its own port: deterministic for identical inputs, no external call, no provider credentials.

LoanApplication.title: Loan Application
LoanApplication.description: Table application. policy_version_id is pinned at submission and never retargeted by a later activation (decision D-D).

DocumentVerificationStatus.title: Document Verification Status
DocumentVerificationStatus.description: An Underwriter ruling on one Application Document. REJECTED requires a non-empty reason, enforced by a CHECK constraint.

ApplicationDocument.title: Application Document
ApplicationDocument.description: Table checklist_item. No file bytes and no storage URL: M1-M3 has no upload surface, so the checklist row is the document.

DocumentChecklist.title: Document Checklist
DocumentChecklist.description: The set of Required Documents generated for one Loan Application at submission, from its pinned Policy Version, item for item.

DocumentVerificationQueue.title: Document Verification Queue
DocumentVerificationQueue.description: Derived read model: Application Documents still PENDING. Already-actioned documents are absent.

UnderwritingDecision.title: Underwriting Decision
UnderwritingDecision.description: Table decision_record. Insert-only; the latest record wins. Cites only Reason Codes declared by policy_version_id.

Override.title: Override
Override.description: An Admin reversal of an AUTO_REJECT: a new decision_record with supersedes_id set, a comment, a Reason Code and an Audit Entry. Never an edit of the prior row.

PolicyViolation.title: Policy Violation
PolicyViolation.description: Refusal of an Application Submission that breaches a Threshold outright. Surfaces as PolicyViolationException; the transaction rolls back and no application row survives.

Loan.title: Loan
Loan.description: Table loan. A disbursed Loan Application. outstanding_principal, delinquency_bucket and days_past_due are the maintained projections (decision D-E).

Installment.title: Installment
Installment.description: Table schedule_installment. Insert-only. No paid flag exists: paid/unpaid is derived from the cumulative ladder against posted Repayments.

RepaymentSchedule.title: Repayment Schedule
RepaymentSchedule.description: Table repayment_schedule, one row per Loan. Insert-only. The stored Installments sum exactly to total_payable, with no epsilon (decision D-C).

FundingSource.title: Funding Source
FundingSource.description: Stubbed origin of disbursed money, recorded for audit. No payment rail is called and no live credential exists.

Disbursement.title: Disbursement
Disbursement.description: Table disbursement. Insert-only, UNIQUE on loan_id — the structural idempotence guard against a repeat disbursement.

Repayment.title: Repayment
Repayment.description: Table repayment_posting. Insert-only. applied_principal + applied_interest = amount, enforced by CHECK. Per D-K, allocation is FIFO across whole Installments and within the oldest unpaid Installment a partial Repayment applies to interest first, then principal.

DaysPastDue.title: Days Past Due
DaysPastDue.description: Whole days between the As-Of Date and the due date of the oldest unpaid Installment. Zero when none is overdue (decision D-B).

DelinquencyBucket.title: Delinquency Bucket
DelinquencyBucket.description: Ageing band from Days Past Due: CURRENT 0-29, DPD-30 30-59, DPD-60 60-89, DPD-90 90-179, NPA 180+ (decision D-B). Boundaries are Config-layer constants. Status only; nothing is charged for lateness.

AsOfDate.title: As-Of Date
AsOfDate.description: The date an End-Of-Day Run evaluates against, making the run replayable and independent of wall-clock time.

EndOfDayRun.title: End-Of-Day Run
EndOfDayRun.description: Derived, not a table. Persisting a run row would break the byte-identical second-run assertion, so the run writes only the loan projections it recomputes plus one Audit Entry.

PortfolioSummary.title: Portfolio Summary
PortfolioSummary.description: Derived read model over stored loan bucket state and overdue Installment amounts. Never invokes the End-Of-Day Run.
